description: The KL-43 Regional Transport Office serves the Mattancherry region within the Kochi metropolitan area of Kerala. Functioning as a Sub-Regional Transport Office (SRTO), it manages vehicle registrations, driving licenses, and permit issuance to alleviate the burden on the main Ernakulam RTO.
address: Hebron Building, Chemman's Junction, West Karuvelipady, Thoppumpady, Kochi, Kerala
